overview: Electric current is the flow of positive charges in a conducting metallic wire. The electric potential difference between two points in an electric circuit carries some current. Work done in moving a charge across two points with a given potential difference is equal to 24 J. This work is done by the cell, which expends its chemical energy stored in it to maintain the current in the circuit. Electricity is a branch of science that deals with the flow of electric charge. The amount of electric charge that flows through a circuit depends on the potential difference between two points and the current flowing through them. key_concepts.description: A continuous and closed path of an electric current is called an electric circuit

key_concepts.name: Variable resistance
key_concepts.description: A component used to regulate current without changing the voltage source is called variable resistance

key_concepts.name: A resistor
key_concepts.description: A conductor having some appreciable resistance is called a resistor
